news.title: INAPAM 2026: When must you renew your card, and when does it remain valid?
news.description: During 2026, older adults who have a credential from the National Institute of Older Adults (INAPAM) do not have to renew it periodically, since the document does not have an expiration date. INAPAM itself has clarified that the credentials issued with different designs in previous years are still valid and can be used in establishments and services that have an agreement with the institute.

news.title: Why did the dollar skyrocket today, September 23, against the Mexican peso?
news.description: On the afternoon of this Wednesday, September 23, 2026, the dollar continues to gain ground against the Mexican peso, while the markets show signs of risk aversion due to the United States' stance on Mexico and energy exports. At the close of the session, the exchange rate was trading at 17.51 pesos per dollar, 22 cents more than the close of Tuesday, September 22, according to the report of the Bank of Mexico (Banxico). Likewise, the behavior in the parity of both currencies occurs after the arrival of Chinese President Xi Jinping to the United States for a three-day state visit in which he will meet with his U.S. counterpart, Donald Trump.

news.title: Pochettino loses the battle with the Mexican-Americans
news.description: The United States' process towards the 2030 World Cup begins with many novelties, but also with an anomaly. For the first time since the World Cup there is no Mexican-American soccer player for the FIFA dates of September and October. Originally, Ricardo Pepi was called up by Pochettino for this window, however, due to an injury he was out and replaced by Damion Downs, leaving without a single Mexican-American player, but also the Argentine coach has lost the battle with Mexico. Of all the Mexican-American soccer players who have worn the U.S. national team jersey in the Pochettino era, only Brian Gutierrez was debuted by Pochettino, and then changed for the Mexican national team.
